To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the co-doped crystals of KBr: Ce, Tb show a broad emission peak of Ce3+ in the blue region and the intensity of emission peak of Tb3+ is reduced when they are excited at 250 nm, and this is due to an efficient energy transfer from Ce3+ ion to Tb3+.
Ce3+ and Tb3+ doped KBr crystals have been prepared and characterized by Optical Absorption (OA), Photoluminescence, Thermoluminescence and Photo stimulated emission.
KBr:Ce3+, Tb3+, crystals have shown a strong luminescence emission at 390 nm, 550 nm, and 620 nm when excited at 250, 300 and 370 nm respectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the luminescence and optical absorption properties of X-ray irradiated KBr:Ce3+ and KBr:Tb, Ce3+ crystals.
the investigation of the luminescence properties of Ce3+ in KBr:Td3+ crystals and the effect of Ce3+ doping on the luminescence of KBr:Tb crystals.
the luminescence and optical absorption studies of KBr: Ce, Tb crystals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the luminescence properties of Ce3+ doped KBr: Tb3+ crystals are strongly dependent on the Ce3+ concentration.
the KBr crystals doped with Tb, Ce ions are good thermoluminescent materials for the dosimetric applications.   1.
the co-doped samples show a significant increase in the TL sensitivity and a reduction in TL emission peak temperatures as compared to undoped samples.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Ce3+ is the best sensitizer in KBr host and it can be used for the development of a new generation of thermoluminescence dosimetric materials.
the luminescence properties of KBr: Ce, Tb crystals are very promising for dosimetry and imaging applications.
the luminescence properties and optical absorption in KBr:Ce3+, Tb3+, and KBr:Ce, Tb crystals were studied and discussed in details.
The main takeaway from our work is that
KBr: Ce, Tb can be considered as a potential candidate for TL dosimetry and for PSL applications.
KBr doped with Tb and Ce ions is a good thermoluminescent dosimeter for low dose range.
the luminescence properties can be tuned by varying the concentration of dopant ions and the host lattice.
